description: This file defines an abstract base class 'GrainService' for implementing partitioned grain-like services within the Orleans distributed framework. It manages lifecycle events, ring range subscriptions, and logging for grain services.

classes.name: GrainService
classes.description: An abstract class providing lifecycle management, range subscription, and logging for grain-like services in Orleans.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the grain service with provided service provider.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the grain service, sets the ring range, and logs startup.

methods.name: StartInBackground
methods.description: Performs deferred startup tasks, sets status to Started.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the grain service, cancels ongoing operations, and logs shutdown.

methods.name: OnRangeChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the ring range, updates internal state, and logs the change.
